highLatitude.hint: North of about 48° latitude the sun no longer dips far enough below the horizon in summer to reach the Fajr and Isha angles. This rule decides how both times are then derived from the length of the night. Depending on the rule, Fajr and Isha can end up as much as an hour apart, and there is no universally accepted answer. If you want to follow your mosque, pick the rule that matches its times.
highLatitude.title: High-latitude rule
